## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:engine` · `area:api`, into `pm:queue`. The conversion walks a package body. Sequenced after #23001

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T11:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 and `target:v18`:** an option-B artifact (ADR-0130 D4) built before any retirement cannot boot after it, because the refusal comes at the metadata door's parse. Every major-18 entry is a suspect, so this sits on v18's upgrade path, beside #22994 and #23001.
- **Direction:**
  - `artifact-forward-conversion.ts` runs the same conversion over each `packages[].manifest` body that it runs over the definition's own collections. ⛔ No second walk with its own entry list.
  - Pins:
    - the option-B dashboard boots, and is served as `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`;
    - a multi-package `packages[]` is converted per body;
    - the definition-collection control stays as it is.
  - The dev measures a config boot (`composeStacks`) of the same shape and reports it.
- **Serial:** #23001 (PR #23023, in flight) changes the window in the same file. This card sequences after it.
- Triage: lands in `packages/metadata-core` (`domain:engine`); rationale: the conversion's reach.

Claim: PM loop round 1 · 2026-10-12T12:00Z
Session: `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX`
Account: `os-steve` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23027-package-body-conversion`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23027`
Domain: `domain:engine`
Seat: `domain:engine#2` (seat post #20966)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `0ede0f8ab3`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report): `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts` (the conversion runs over each `packages[].manifest` body, by the same walk and the same entry list); its tests under `packages/metadata-core/src/`; `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` only where the door must hand the package bodies through, with its test; one changeset. If a config boot (`composeStacks`) of the same shape needs a fix outside these files, stop and report it. ⛔ No second walk with its own entry list. ⛔ Not #22994's `AppPlugin` registration seam.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
- ADR-0087's at-rest supersession reads: "Metadata at rest has no author to teach, so it replays the full chain, retired entries included — … and a compiled artifact inside the versioned window its own manifest opens". An option-B artifact (ADR-0130 D4) is such an artifact, and its package bodies are refused only because the conversion never reaches them. If the dev adds an exported member (a new verdict or option), the declaration becomes `yes` and the dev names it.
Responsibility: the conversion's reach is `metadata-core`'s (`artifact-forward-conversion.ts` walks only the definition's own collections) · no platform path converts a package body today · every option-B artifact built before a retirement reaches it, measured at the public door `os dev -a dist/objectstack.json --fresh` (#22994's dev, 6122651929).
Thread-read: 6122964017
Serial constraints cleared:
- #23001 landed (PR #23023, `58f5c90999`), which was this card's ordering (same file).
- No open PR touches `artifact-forward-conversion.ts` or `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`, and no in-flight claim names them (read at this stamp).
- #22994 (PR #23024, `domain:cli`) is `AppPlugin`'s seam, disjoint.
